Third-party components / Üçüncü taraf bileşenler
================================================

Game Monitor (Oyun Monitörü) itself is MIT licensed (see LICENSE).
The release package also contains the following unmodified third-party files
in the bin\ folder. They are NOT part of this project's source repository.

Oyun Monitörü'nün kendisi MIT lisanslıdır (LICENSE). Release paketi bin\
klasöründe aşağıdaki değiştirilmemiş üçüncü taraf dosyaları da içerir; bunlar
bu projenin kaynak deposunda yer almaz.


1) bin\PresentMon.exe
---------------------
Intel PresentMon console application, version 2.6.0 (PresentMon-2.6.0-x64.exe)
Source:   https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon (tag v2.6.0)
Download: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/tag/v2.6.0
SHA-256:  b2a706bc6ad475749e3b7e3409263aa1e6906d45bdcf993f6dbc0f660188f1af
License:  MIT, Copyright (C) 2017-2024 Intel Corporation
          -> PresentMon-LICENSE.txt
          Third-party notices of PresentMon -> PresentMon-THIRD_PARTY.txt


2) bin\IntelMSR.bin
-------------------
PawnIO module "IntelMSR" from PawnIO.Modules, version 0.2.11
(release_0_2_11.zip)
Source:   https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules (tag 0.2.11, file IntelMSR.p)
Download: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.11
SHA-256:  d6ed85d65ab17a22f813ef98207d6d537155ee2ded5976a21cb48413c9b92e5f
License:  GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later (LGPL-2.1-or-later),
          Copyright (C) 2025 namazso <admin@namazso.eu>
          -> PawnIO.Modules-COPYING.txt
          The complete corresponding source code of this exact version is
          included in the release package as PawnIO.Modules-0.2.11-src.zip
          (unmodified GitHub source archive of tag 0.2.11).
          Bu sürümün kaynak kodunun tamamı release paketinde
          PawnIO.Modules-0.2.11-src.zip olarak yer alır.

The module runs inside the PawnIO driver, which is NOT included and must be
installed separately from https://pawnio.eu/ (namazso).
Modül PawnIO sürücüsü içinde çalışır; sürücü pakete dahil değildir, ayrıca
https://pawnio.eu/ adresinden kurulmalıdır.
